links.comparator_used: Original, unrewritten neurosurgical patient education materials from top US hospitals
links.outcome: Readability of patient education materials (FRE, Flesch-Kincaid, Gunning Fog, ARI, Coleman-Liau, SMOG) and accuracy after ChatGPT-4 rewriting toward an eighth-grade level
links.effect: Mean FRE score for rewritten PEMs was significantly lower than for nonrewritten materials on each topic (P < .01), except spinal stenosis (P = .104). Original PEMs scored significantly above an eighth-grade level on all measures (P < .01 to P < .001). Rewritten PEMs were validated for accuracy.
links.quote: The mean FRE score for rewritten PEMs on each topic were significantly lower than nonrewritten materials ( P < .01) except spinal stenosis ( P = .104) and were validated for accuracy.

design_hint: reading-level constraint prompting for patient education materials
